leak.l6.stopped: sing-box engine is stopped or failing!
leak.l6.stopped_guard_on: The container forward guard is still on: device packets that do not go through tun0 are dropped and do not fall back to a direct path.
leak.l6.stopped_guard_off: The container forward guard is not active: only the router kill-switch now keeps devices from going direct.
leak.l6.running: sing-box engine is running in fail-closed mode (cuts all traffic if the proxy is lost, blocks WebRTC STUN over UDP)
leak.l6.guard_active_details: The container drops every forwarded packet that does not go through tun0 (installed at startup).
leak.l6.guard_off: sing-box engine is running, but the container forward guard is turned off
leak.l6.guard_off_details: FORWARD_GUARD=off: if sing-box stops, the container forwards packets back to the router and only the router kill-switch stops them.
leak.l6.guard_unavailable: sing-box engine is running, but the container forward guard could not be installed
leak.l6.guard_unavailable_details: The router kernel does not let the container use iptables (or NET_ADMIN is missing). If sing-box stops, only the router kill-switch stops traffic.
leak.l6.guard_unknown: sing-box engine is running, but the container forward guard state is unknown
leak.l6.guard_unknown_details: The program was not started through entrypoint.sh, so there is no information about the FORWARD rule.
